correctness.rationale: For ordinary tree metric with equal arms one and stem h>0, and nonnegative coefficients, traced the cited spanning-tree norm formula to three numerator trees and the one-Steiner denominator. Normalize u+v=1; both numerator branches divided by denominator strictly increase as t=min(u,v) rises to 1/2. For u=v, the numerator branches cross only at h_p, with pre-crossing derivative changing from negative to positive at h=1/2 and positive gain decreasing after crossing. Boundary h->0 and h->infinity cannot exceed 1. Independent grid evaluation: p=1/2 gain 1, p=2/3 gain 1.027846053421092 at h=6.5463652424, p=.9 gain 1.046757382. The analytic proof, not the grid, covers all 0<p<1.
